name: Philemon
tagline: A plea for a runaway slave
author: The apostle Paul.
setting: Paul writes to Philemon about Onesimus.
theme: The gospel changes relationships, making masters and slaves brothers.

outline.label: Prayer for the sharing of faith
No longer as a slave but as a beloved brother
Refresh my heart and prepare a guest room

christInBook: Paul appeals for Onesimus on the basis of love, as one who stands in Christ’s place for a debtor, “charge that to my account” (v. 18). The letter pictures what Christ has done for us.
howToRead: Philemon is a personal letter and a model of persuasion. Notice how Paul appeals instead of commanding, and how he reframes Onesimus as a brother.
